checks.name: one structural sampler change
checks.evidence: face_center delegates to the unchanged nearest-members path. face_region preserves center KNN, reads 16 nearest points by squared normal distance plus squared tangential overflow to each bounded rectangle, and encodes Euclidean face-center distance. The inherited 14-D member encoding, 109-D whole-range evidence, 1302-D aggregate, 6x33 decoder and 456102 parameters remain unchanged. It does not claim uniform face coverage or use GT.

checks.name: actual parent order and one forward
checks.evidence: Exact revision2 pv_ground.py calls geometry after native Masks, then zero-R readback, then the deferred native semantic subhead. forward_pair captures the actual pre-head query/raw/original coarse arguments, executes one observed parent forward, and runs only the external second geometry head. Source asserts refiner/readback/native-semantic event order and one semantic call.

checks.name: criterion graphs and shared-list mutation
checks.evidence: Native losses.py matches the declared actual port digest. Its seven prefixes are proposal,last,0head..4head; matches[1] is last. The criterion consumes per-arm last_center/last_pred_size, detached last_sem_cls_scores, pre-readback frozen projections, and frozen Mask lists. B overwrites native/reference/p3 geometry metadata, own boundary logits/floor fields, neighbor distances, and final boxes. Native criterion adds losses only to each independent top-level dictionary and reads the shared lists without mutation. The remaining A-linked last_semantic_query_after_readback field is not consumed by native/G/DFL/extra geometry losses. No unexpected A-gradient path was found in B criterion.

checks.name: independent optimization and preserved loss
checks.evidence: Two disjoint head parameter sets and separate AdamW optimizers use LR1e-5, WD0.0005, clip0.1. Each arm has its own native matching and native+G+DFL/7+query-supported geometry objective, matching the previous lambda0 recipe. The A score detach removes only the path through the verified frozen zero-output R. Both gradients are cleared; after each backward the other head and parent must have no gradients.

checks.name: rebuild and parameterless sampler metadata
checks.evidence: Each arm payload carries sampling_mode, its ten state tensors, optimizer, step/history and source identities. Factory rebuilds official+G+protected reference, installs the declared sampler and strictly loads its delta. CPU M0 restore resets constructor RNG to2027 before each full rebuild so frozen zero-R hidden state is reproduced, checks every full model state against initial+delta, checks mode, restores Adam groups/moments/steps, and asserts two steps. Geometry modes, nonpersistent layout buffers and boundary/reference modes are recreated by constructors. No old failed geometry terminal is used.

checks.name: fresh start, counts and budgets
checks.evidence: Preflight runs two actual optimizer steps per head on the selected actual augmented B8 batch and uses BytesIO only. Fit is a separate process freshly rebuilt from the protected step0 payload. The training loop asserts29778 rows once,3723 updates, B8/lastB2, and unchanged parent/R state. Terminal payload history is11169+steps for hidden tensors and steps for reset outputs; no multiseed or LR change is introduced.

checks.name: dataset GT and native evaluation
checks.evidence: Actual dataset mirror digest matches appearance_source_manifest and historical imports. Root GT is dataset center_label/size_gts and member masks; training native jitter is preserved, evaluation disables augmentation. Predicted detections are used with butd_gt=False/butd_cls=False. Fixed split has29778 unique fit and6887 unique holdout rows with no overlap; runner additionally verifies physical scene separation. Formal val asserts9508. Native bbs score and GT evaluator are used for both heads; selected IoU counts and Mask sums are compared against the native evaluator.

checks.name: persisted comparison scope
checks.evidence: Current clarified plan agrees with code: initial_formal/formal retain one same-parent all256 NPZ per batch containing shared row IDs/GT/native score/reference/original prior/validity and both finals. The6887 initial/terminal holdout retains selected-row JSON and all256 coverage summaries only. Same-forward arm/reference comparisons are identifiable; historical5598/4848 remains a separate protected comparator.

checks.name: M0 witness coverage
checks.evidence: Source plans full center-index/distance identity,384 independent projected-rectangle checks per B8 witness, actual raw-member reference recomputation, neutral decode identity, frozen parent/R and common Mask/score/reference checks, two-step finite/nonzero head gradients, no cross-head gradients, CPU1304-state and Adam roundtrip, and measured peak memory/whole-process elapsed time. None of these neural checks was executed by this review.

checks.name: source bindings and syntax
checks.evidence: Eight remote Python modules and the two embedded remote snippets parse with Python3.7 grammar under the existing local Python3.12.6 interpreter. Three Windows-only preparation/deployment/observer scripts parse locally. All17 declared helper digests and all5 current factory/sampler/reference/loop bindings match. Exact port, losses, main_utils, prepare_data, evaluator, dataset manifest and split digests match their declarations. No Python or package environment was changed.

checks.name: M0 deployer and sole observer
checks.evidence: Deployer checks a SOURCE_ONLY no-blocking review and every reviewed-file digest before SSH; this manifest includes the deployer and observer themselves. It checks previous completed audit/weight-retention status, existing env digest, protected reference weight, idle GPU, new nonexisting root and >64MiB M0 disk reserve. It uploads byte-identical reviewed sources, uses the existing GPU flock and only --phase preflight. Observer waits11minutes from launch then240seconds, collects only after controller exit, and has no NN launch or deletion path.

checks.name: claim and downstream gates
checks.evidence: Threshold5620/4764 applies to one final Scan model, three effective contributions are still required, and Sr3D/Nr3D remain downstream independent author-weight fits at seed2027. Current source is neither a precision result nor evidence of an effective third contribution. A separately prepared formal-fit launcher/FIT review is outside this M0 gate.

limits: Local source and retained source mirrors only; actual remote filesystem, weights, GPU memory and neural graphs were not executed or newly attested.
The real two-update paired GPU preflight and CPU full-state/Adam restore must pass before formal fit; source assertions are not runtime results.
M0 elapsed_seconds measures the whole preflight including startup, fixtures and CPU reconstruction; it is not an isolated neural throughput measurement.
This review admits only the current M0 source gate. The separately prepared launch_fit_authorized.py and any FIT_SOURCE_REVIEW are outside this manifest.
Same-family independent context is provisional; no cross-family acceptance or actual model/backend identity is claimed.
summary: No real blocking or nonblocking source defect found in the reviewed paired runner, sampler, native dependency graph, restoration path and M0 deployment/observer. Current protected5598/4848 and the user objective are unchanged.
